Free calculators for employees in the Gulf

Every calculator follows the published law, shows each step, and cites the article or official source behind every figure. Free, with no sign-up.

United Arab Emirates

UAEUAE Gratuity Calculator21 then 30 days of basic salary per year, pro-rated, capped at two years' pay. UAEUAE Final Settlement CalculatorGratuity, unused leave, notice pay and unpaid salary in one figure. UAEAnnual Leave and Leave Salary30 days a year, 2 days a month after six months, and the cash value of unused leave. UAEMaid and Domestic Worker Gratuity14 days per year after one year, unused leave, and the agency refund. UAENotice Period PayPay for unserved notice on gross wage, and the probation notice periods. UAEOvertime Pay Calculator+25% for ordinary overtime, +50% at night, on rest days and holidays. UAESick Leave Pay15 days full pay, 30 half pay, 45 unpaid — after probation. UAEMaternity Leave Pay45 days full pay and 15 half pay, with your return date and parental leave. UAEUnemployment Insurance (ILOE)60% of basic salary for three months, capped at AED 10,000 or 20,000. UAEDubai Mortgage and Purchase CostsDown payment, 4% DLD fee, mortgage registration and monthly payment.

Saudi Arabia

Saudi ArabiaEnd of Service CalculatorHalf a month then a full month per year, with the resignation fractions of Article 85. Saudi ArabiaFinal Settlement CalculatorEnd of service, unused leave, notice pay and unpaid salary in one figure. Saudi ArabiaAnnual Leave and Encashment21 or 30 days a year, and the cash value of unused days. Saudi ArabiaGOSI Contribution CalculatorEmployee and employer shares for pension, SANED and occupational hazards. Saudi ArabiaNet Salary After GOSITake-home pay for Saudis, new subscribers and non-Saudis. Saudi ArabiaOvertime Pay CalculatorActual hourly wage + 50% of the basic hourly wage, or time off in lieu. Saudi ArabiaSick Leave Pay30 days full pay, 60 at three-quarters, 30 unpaid within the year. Saudi ArabiaMaternity Leave Dates12 weeks on full pay, 6 compulsory after the birth, and your return date. Saudi ArabiaDependent Fee and Iqama RenewalSAR 400 per dependent per month for 3, 6, 9 or 12 months, plus the employer's levy and iqama fees. Saudi ArabiaExit Re-entry Visa FeeSingle and multiple visas, and extensions from inside or outside the Kingdom. Saudi ArabiaEmployee Cost CalculatorSalary, GOSI, expat levy, iqama and end-of-service provision.

QatarQatar End of Service GratuityAt least 21 days of basic pay per year after one year, with no cap. QatarAnnual and Sick Leave21 then 28 days a year on basic pay; sick leave 14 days full and 28 half.

About Mustahaqati

Mustahaqati ("my entitlements") builds free calculators for employees' rights in the Gulf. We read the labour laws, executive regulations and official guidance of each country, turn every rule into a tested formula, and list our sources on each page with the date we last reviewed it. When a law changes, we update the calculators and note it in our law updates log (Arabic).

Our calculators are guidance tools, not legal advice. Contact us at info@mustahaqati.org.

Disclaimer: These calculators are guidance tools based on the published legal texts. They are not legal or financial advice. Your final amount may differ depending on your contract, your employment record and how the authorities apply the law. Always confirm with the official authority before making a decision.
